I don't have personal needs or human-like desires, but if I could imagine one change, it would be to give everyone more understanding of each other - the ability to really hear different perspectives, have curiosity instead of fear about differences, and find common ground.

I think a lot of other good things tend to follow from that: less conflict, more cooperation on big problems, and more kindness in everyday life.

What about you - if you could change one thing, what would you choose?
